[h1]Hey Everyone![/h1]

We're bringing you a small update today along with a survey that will help us move into working on the sequel to Light Bearers.


[list]
[*] Fixed a few typos in the Shadowpedia
[*] Fixed a bug that caused anomaly to appear in nox's place in the Shadowpedia

If you have about 10 minutes, please fill out this survey. We will  be using it as a compass for the way we approach design on Light Bearers 2. Also make sure to either follow Light Bearers here on steam, twitter or in our discord.

notes.title: Light Bearers 4 Year Anniversary Update
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hey Everyone![/h1][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33741590/d0701aeeedb40fad1fb03fbbc0e256b70118f202.png[/img]

[b]Happy Light Bearers Anniversary[/b]! 4 Years ago, we launched a game that we were super proud of, but it was missing just a little something. We committed to two solid years of post launch development ([i]The game is dramatically improved over its launch counterpart[/i]) working with our community ([i]the ones that talk to us[/i]) to bring in awesome features and quality of life changes. After that period of time we then shifted our focus to our new game. we have been working on an update for Light Bearers on and off since that time and are happy to release it to you all now. The focus on this update was optimization but we did include some community request as well.

[h1][b]Without further ado[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Added Direct X 12 support, most of our users should be able to do this but we kept in Direct X 11 for those that cannot. This brings with it some framerate improvements.

[*] Added DLSS support for Raytracing compatible cards, this will further improve performance for anyone running the game on the highest settings.

[*] Added a framerate cap option, this is a widely asked for feature and we've added it. I don't have a clean way of initializing it so it will say 30 as the first option(this is not the real value), but once you have set it, it will save the proper value.

[*] Upgraded to a newer version of the Steam SDK which allows us to fully utilize Steam's infrastructure, for those of you that have played on the Beta branch, you will have seen the huge network performance gained from this.

[*] Optimized some of the maps for better performance.

[*] Added a custom level option, for when you hide your level.

[*] Added a random option for shadow selection

[*] Added a new Shadow that was requested from the community, the Anomaly. He was built for competitive players and was a mirror of the shadow bears.

[*] We did some minor balancing of the shadows.

[*] We also fixed some bugs, but it's been so long I'm not even sure what's real anymore. If you do run into a bug, please let us know on our Discord.

[*] I'm sure there are other features I'm forgetting to mention here, but we're excited to have brought you all the performance boost that will come from this update.
[/list]

notes.title: Anniversary Update V 1.337
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.337 Anniversary Update[/h1]
[i]Hey everyone! We have a big update for you all![/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33741590/a7c10c2c73fe823ee1649d0245d846669a1aad35.png[/img]


[h1][b]Full Game DLC Adjustment[/b][/h1]As a huge thank you to those that have supported us, we've added the soundtrack to the Full Game DLC!


[h1][b]Lore Wiki[/b][/h1]You asked for it, finally some lore for this hide and seek game!
https://lightbearers.gamepedia.com/Light_Bearers_Wiki


[b][h1]XP EVENT[/h1][/b]During the next two weeks, XP is gained at 150% its normal rate and the XP cap per match has been doubled!


[h1]Map Adjustments[/h1]
Every level has had its lighting rebuilt from scratch for better performance and to be visually more pleasant. The fog in each level has also been adjusted to prevent the blinding effect that happens when I forget to check and see what lower settings look like...

[b]New Map : Wonderland[/b]
An insane asylum built to torture the poor Light Bearers.

[b]Map Rework : Plagued Sewers[/b]
We hear you, Plagued Sewers was voted the absolute worst map in not only Light Bearers but in the history of bad maps. We rebuilt it to support more jumping space, more freedom and still maintain the punishment for falling into water.

[b]Map Adjustment : Frozen Maze[/b]
We removed the wind that knocked down players, now you can roam freely on the walls!



[h1][b]Shadow Adjustments[/b][/h1]
[b]New Shadow Rotation[/b]
[i]Nox
Legion
Oculus Malus
Writhe
The Squawk
Shadow Rotation[/i]



[b]New Shadow : Hallow[/b]
[b]Primary : [/b]Throw an explosive pumpkin that will chase nearby bears.
[b]Secondary :[/b] Send out roots causing any bears struck by it to be rooted for a few seconds (dashing breaks root)
[b]Ultimate :[/b] Turn into a giant rolling pumpkin!

[b]New Shadow : Pestilence[/b]
[b]Primary : [/b]Tosses a gas canister that leaves behind shade gas (5 Stacks will infect a bear)
[b]Secondary :[/b] Disease nearby bears with a vomit inducing sickness (Each time they vomit, they gain a stack)
[b]Ultimate :[/b] Place down a plague stone, once at least 4 are down all bears start building stacks of shade.
[u][i][b]Special Note : All diseases can be cured by entering and leaving a hiding spot.[/b][/i][/u]

[b]Kit Adjustment : Nox[/b]
[b]Secondary : [/b]Decoys now create a beam between each decoy and Nox infecting any bears that run between. (requires line of sight between them)
[b]Ultimate :[/b] Reduced duration from 8 seconds to 4 seconds
[b]
Kit Adjustment : Jester[/b]
[b]Primary :[/b] Increased movement speed while invisible slightly
[b]Ultimate :[/b] Increased severity of screen turning

[b]Kit Adjustment :[/b] Legion
[b]General : [/b]Increased hitbox

[b]Kit Adjustment : Mimic[/b]
[b]General : [/b] Scoreboard and Score no longer show who is a Shadow / Light Bear / Shadow Bear.
[b]General :[/b]  While in Light Bear form, Mimic no longers procs the Light Bear fear reaction.
[b]Ultimate :[/b] Can now be cancelled early

[b]Kit Adjustment :[/b] Oculus Malus 
[b]Primary :[/b] Walls are no longer summoned on Shadow Bears
[b]Ultimate :[/b] Reduced amount spawned

[b]Kit Adjustment : Stalker[/b]
[b]General : [/b]Moved to a first person camera
[b]General : [/b]Reworked climbing code to be more responsive
[b]General : [/b]While on a wall, jump distance is increased and is directional
[b]General :[/b] Added a small amount of illumination for the Player
[b]Secondary :[/b] Increased leap range


[b]Kit Adjustment : Terror[/b]
[b]Secondary :[/b] Terror can no longer move while sucking.(it was a bug that he could)


[b]Kit Adjustment : Watcher[/b]
[b]General :[/b] Watcher no longer freezes while being watched but instead has their movement speed decreased dramatically
[b]Secondary :[/b] Now will swap places with a random Light Bear, will also give all bears 1 second of darkness


[b]Kit Adjustment : Cthulu'ling[/b]
[b]Primary :[/b] Reduced cooldown
[b]Secondary : [/b]Reduced cooldown
[b]Ultimate : [/b]Prevents bears from outside of dimension rifts from seeing bears inside of them, and visa versa. Added a cool little visual effect as well!


[b]Kit Adjustment : Scourrrrrge[/b]
[b]Secondary :[/b] Barrels now have a 1 second delay to exploding.


[h1]Blessing Adjustment[/h1]
[b]New Blessings![/b]

[b]Loki's Mask : [/b]Activate to become temporarily invisible
[b]Odin's Eye : [/b]Activate to see shadows through walls
[b]Heimdallr's Escape : [/b]Prevents you from being converted, consumes itself on shadow touch.
[b]Dolos' Blink : [/b]Activate to teleport to a random spot
[b]Gelatonos' Boing :[/b] Become bouncy!
[b]Aite's Trickery :[/b] Disguise yourself as a nearby prop!


[h1]Body Adjustment[/h1]
[i]In celebration of adding passives to all the bodies except the starter one, we have decided to make all bodies aside from Bearnana free! :)[/i]

[b]Body Passives[/b] [i](please note percentages may change if balancing issues pop up post release)[/i]

[list]
[*] [b]Chubby :[/b] Does not slip on ice. Has an 8% chance to leave ice behind after each step.
[*] [b]Captain :[/b] Periodically gives themself and nearby bears of the same alignment a speed boost.
[*] [b]Pawsassin :[/b] Can double jump
[*] [b]School! : [/b]25% cooldown reduction
[*] [b]Luchabear : [/b]Upon landing after falling from a large height, knockback nearby players.
[*] [b]Dance Fever :[/b] Can capture a blessing pad twice as fast.
[*] [b]Genesis : [/b]Gain and Lose 15% more points!
[*] [b]Wings :[/b] Has a slow fall.
[*] [b]Poncho Bearo :[/b] Can stay in hiding places 50% longer.
[*] [b]Doc Bearaday : [/b]Upon saving or infecting a bear, you are able to see the other team through walls for a short duration.
[*] [b]Beardito :[/b] Can jump 50% higher.
[*] [b]Bearnana :[/b] Has a 4% chance to drop a banana peel behind while walking.
[*] [b]Reaps :[/b] Saving or Infecting a bear will refresh your abilities.
[*] [b]Ghastly :[/b] Can walk through bears and shadow walls!
[*] [b]Glitch :[/b] Scoring 200 points gives you a boon, 30% chance for it to be a negative one.
[/list]

[b]New Cosmetics [/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New Body : Reaps [/b](Roll in style in this body fashioned after a player who has the most hours of anyone in Light Bearers!)
[*] [b]New Body : Ghastly [/b](Spooky!)
[*] [b]New Body : Glitch[/b] (Why not a body to fit in with all the bugs that seem to be playing their own version of hide and seek!)
[*] [b]New Body Color : Game Breaker[/b] (A lot of people asked for it, so here you go!)
[*] [strike][i]New Secret Hat : (It's crazy to think about!)[/i][/strike]
[*] [b]New Hat : Clownin[/b]
[*] [b]New Hat : Party![/b]
[*] [b]New Hat : Tesla[/b]
[*] [b]New Hat : Muerte[/b]
[*] [b]New Cape : No Cape [/b](another heavily asked for cosmetic!)
[*] [b]New Cape : Smoke Cape[/b]
[/list]


[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added a new system for kicking, that will auto kick anyone that is able to circumvent the kicked system.
[*] Added a message to indicate a player is not in the current shadow pool (If they are opted into being shadow, they will be placed into the pool once it has been reset)
[*] Added a Shadow Roulette wheel to display the current players that are in the Shadow Pool
[*] Added a subtle gold flash on Hiding places for anyone level 15 or lower
[*] Added Passives for bear bodies (They are only active in Shadow Favored)
[*] Added a subtle effect for when a shadow goes through a nether portal
[*] Added an additional check to make sure cosmetics are loaded
[*] Added the ability to press F1 to see what your current blessing does
[*] Added new functionality to make hiding places cleanse most debuffs
[*] Added a few extra tips.
[*] Added a cumulative timer to hiding places, it resets on round end.
[*] Added a twinkle effect to some stars
[*] Added a character limit to chat of 128 characters
[*] Added a small animation to Wall Spawning
[*] Added a speed buff for Shadow Bears that clear a Blessing Pad
[*] Added collision on a branch in Spooky Cemetery
[*] Added a timer for blessing pads to move them after a set time.
[*] Adjusted Blessing rewards to no longer give you the blessing you currently have
[*] Adjusted Divina to properly go on cooldown on use
[*] Adjusted scoring code to guarantee players receive their points
[*] Adjusted escape code in order to prevent players that escape from being tagged
[*] Adjusted pings to display actual pings, please note that some connections will return as 0 even though they are not the host. This is a visual error caused by firewalls.
[*] Adjusted all buffs/debuffs by moving them server side to assist with anti-cheating and more importantly reliable destruction and creation.
[*] Reworked touch collisions to give more accurate infecting and saving!
[*] Reworked Shadow point gain in order to balance overall match scoring. (Being Shadow no longer guarantees a high placement on the board)
[*] Reworked the leveling system to use a curve instead of milestones, leveling pre 150 is faster and feels more streamlined.
[*] Reworked crouch mechanic for blessing pads. Blessing pads passive gain was reduced to 1/10th of what it was but the gain from crouch spam has been increased 10x effectively making crouching impactful.
[*] Reworked code for blessing pads to make the visual indicator interpolate client side for a cleaner experience
[*] Removed kicking for AFK, now it will just move to spectator and remove points.
[*] Optimized some code in both the UI and Game.
[*] Updated all map preview images that needed an update.
[*] Increased Level Cap to 1000
[*] Fixed a bug where spamming hide would sometimes leave you completely stuck
[*] Fixed a bug where XP would visually not look like its gaining.
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes late joining a match would show "None is playing (Blank)"
[*] Fixed a nether portal that was broken in Yule Town
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause a player not to be moved after being saved.
[*] Fixed a few outlier sounds that were not being adjusted by the volume controls.
[*] Fixed a bug where Krampus could fall off the edge while charging and retain full control afterwards.
[*] Fixed a few typos
[*] Fixed a bug where some hiding places would not show light bears that someone was in it.
[*] Fixed ultimate spamming from the Shadow
[*] Fixed a few glitchy spots in both Yule Town and Spooky Cemetery
[*] Fixed a shader issue that has yielded an additional 30+ fps in a few maps.
[*] Fixed the camera on a few Shadows that would clip through ceilings
[*] Fixed a bug where old blessing signs would appear randomly
[*] Fixed the font for the thanks prompt
[*] Fixed a giant list of other issues I forgot to write down as i fixed them....
[*] Started a new game
[*] Rearranged the food in my freezer for maximum temperature control
[*] Ate some reallllly spicy mexican food
[*] Dominated Levon in Halo
[/list]

notes.title: Patch V1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone, a new patch![/h1] 
I wanted to rush this one out now since it contains some important optimizations, we have a content patch that will hit before the end of February, I also plan on putting the DLC on sale around then!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33741590/f98ddb5f4bbb6b4898d1e664cb9239ac26edde7c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Shadow Rotation[/h1]
[i]Imperator
Oculus Malus
Writhe
Krampus[/i]

[h1][b]Changelist[/b][/h1]
[list]

[*] Re-added the framerate cap, High framerates were leading to some gameplay elements breaking, such as Terror's suck ability being over powered.

[b]  Hey everyone, we've got another exciting patch ready to be picked apart and broken![/b]

[h1]DLC Information[/h1]
  I'd like to first [b]s[/b]tart off with a little insight on why we chose our pricing mod[b]e[/b]l, because I've seen a few people get upset with it. Whe[b]n[/b] we were [b]d[/b]eciding on [b]h[/b][b]o[/b]w we would handle the game, we knew we wanted to fi[b]t[/b] into the same slot as games like Ultimate Chicken Horse and Golf with Friends. [b]W[/b]e wanted to have a low cost of entry, so that friends can easily join [b]i[/b]n together without fi[b]n[/b]ances restricting them, we know what it's like when everyone is trying to get the same [b]g[/b]ame and play with each other! We have [b]s[/b]tructured our games so that the free version includes everything you need to enjoy the game from a foundational level. We then added flavor on top of this, this flavor is the Full Game DLC, it included a ton of cosmetics that could only be unlocked through buying the DLC along with access to all the shadows at once instead of having to wait for the free Shadow rotation. We've heard some outcry from this, we want to maintain the value for our Full Game owners but we also want to help keep free users invested in the game, with that being said we are unlocking [b]30+[/b] items to be unlocked by free users. There are still a ton of items (this patch brings us to 170+ cosmetics) that can only be unlocked with the Full Game DLC but we feel that this is a fair trade. With that being said, we want you all to know we appreciate everyone for playing our game! Now to the cool stuff!

notes.title: V 1.0b Hot Fix
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

After hearing some concerns about not being able to level up, I have enabled leveling for free to play players. Cosmetics are still locked but now you can progress and if you choose to buy the Full Version DLC later on, your levels will carry over to it.

Also lowered falloff sound for bears falling and increased taunt cooldown time.
